status: UNAPPROVED technical static candidate. Generated input + deterministic resample/curation; not hand-pixel-authored, not art approval, no animation, no runtime/default adoption, no game-source change.
rejectedPredecessor: v17r2 8759026a (procedural texel authoring) rejected by the creator

provenance.inputKind: generated image selected by Codex (generator output; transparent, pixel-looking, irregular grid ~8.0-8.9 src px by FFT); production input, not native pixel art, not approved
provenance.resampling: palette-index cell mode (central 60% window), coverage>=0.5 alpha; no filtering/dither

displayRequirement: draw_texture_rect(texture, Rect2(round(x)-32, 204, 68, 72)), nearest; same as v17/v17r2
proportion: occupied rows 3..135 (133 rows) = v17r2 occupied rows; no scale change hidden in cropping

rules: fill transparent texels with 4/4 opaque orthogonal neighbours (orth. majority colour)
interior texel whose colour matches none of 8 opaque neighbours -> neighbour majority if >=5/8; face box exempt

layerRule.method: MASK SLICES of the single flattened curated still (partition, no overlap, nothing painted behind)
layerRule.scarf: teal hue 165-200, sat>0.35, anywhere (neck wrap + trailing tail)
layerRule.hair: brown (hue<45,sat>0.3,non-skin) above source y 470, largest 4-connected mass only
layerRule.head: remaining non-dark, non-navy texels above source y 470 (skin, eyes, brows, mouth, ear)
layerRule.legs: non-dark, non-navy texels below source y 742 (trousers, knee pad, straps, boots)
layerRule.body: everything else (jacket, vest, belt, pouch, arms, gloves)
layerRule.outlines: dark texels (V<0.22) take the majority part of their 8 neighbours, iterated

palette.method: PIL median-cut, no dither: 26 over all kept opaque source pixels + 4 over low-saturation light pixels in the sword box; nearest mapping

inspectionNote: inspection-x4-grey is nearest x4 on flat grey for viewing only; it is not runtime art
limits: 640x360 native path samples 1 of 4 native texels (nearest) so 1-texel face features alias there
layers are slices of a flattened still; moving a part reveals holes (no painted occluded pixels)
outline continuity after resampling is not re-drawn; generator outline breaks are kept
automated gates are technical only; face quality needs visual judgement at actual size
